decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric very close to the firm's established capabilities, it benefits from strong absorptive capacity and remains more likely to be refined than withdrawn.

Its functional flame-retardant curtain positioning fits the firm's existing contract-textile knowledge and in-house development base, making continued improvement commercially more plausible than exit.
Although still the most vulnerable because of its narrower and less prominent niche, it builds on related weaving and design knowledge that the firm can continue to absorb and adapt.

This new braided-structure fabric has strong relatedness to the firm's upholstery and curtain expertise and its dedicated launch suggests management will give it time to learn from the market and optimize it.
